Explosive Press Conference by @Pawankhera 

Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma’s wife holds passports from three countries

1.  United Arab Emirates
2.  Egypt
3.  Antigua and Barbuda

How can an Indian citizen have passports from three countries? 

@himantabiswa The nation https://t.co/v7Ukc0uYXW
post.author_description: Official Twitter handle of Assam Pradesh Congress Committee.

description.description: A series of frames showing an Indian politician, Pawan Khera, addressing a press conference or giving an interview with a large backdrop of what appears to be a passport of Antigua and Barbuda. He is wearing a white shirt and a beige Nehru jacket (waistcoat) and speaks with varied hand gestures across the frames.
description.ocrText: PASSPORT PASAPORTE Type PA Country code ATG BHUYAN RINIKI Nationality ANTIGUAN BARBUDAN Date of birth 31 JUL 73 Authority PASSPORT OF AB00573
